quote: President Biden is working to build a durable peace in the Middle East bolstered by regional integration, a strong coalition to counter and deter Iran and prevent it and its terrorist proxies from threatening the security of the region, and a negotiated two-state solution that ensures Israel’s future as a Jewish and democratic state with recognized borders and upholds the right of Palestinians to live in freedom and security in a viable state of their own.

sourceTitle.en: 2024 Democratic Party Platform (PDF, undated; text published by the DNC in its press release of August 18, 2024, for a delegate vote the next day), p. 83

summary.en: The 2024 platform says President Biden is working toward a negotiated two-state solution that ensures Israel’s future as a Jewish and democratic state and upholds Palestinians’ right to a viable state of their own.
